summary: Preserve anonymous dated planning, explicit bed/room price units and occupancy-derived party estimates, with only manual stale local observations.
reason: Hostelworld anonymous search uses a current public first-party application identifier; dated dorm prices are per bed and private rooms must be booked whole. Generic provider sync and arbitrary live text search are unsupported and must never imply a fresh full snapshot. Greptile review exposed cross-profile manual cache paths, orphaned FTS retention, UTC-versus-source-local date validation, and availability-wide cancellation wrongly applied to deposit-only plans. Related boundaries keep workflow cache status and MCP context paths profile-scoped; dated discovery labels its property-summary cancellation signal separately from rate terms.
validated_outcome: Regression tests preserve source bed/room amounts, isolate verified-profile CLI/MCP cache paths, cap resources and FTS at 200 with orphan cleanup, accept still-current source-local dates, and exclude conditional deposit rates from the free-cancellation filter. Independent overlay regressions also verify actual CLI/MCP reads under two synthetic profiles and transaction rollback on forced FTS deletion failure; ordinary agent and packaged MCP retain decision fields.
